title: Idea Contract
description: Candidate idea proposed by Dreamer. Input to Main for intent-review and main-review.

what_should_exist.description: Concrete description of what would be built

why_now.description: What recent evidence makes this candidate worth surfacing now

evidence_refs.description: Specific research-input files supporting this idea

out_of_scope.description: Things explicitly NOT to do as part of this work

parent_criteria_refs.description: Decomposition trace (§9 LOW). Criterion ids this child idea owns from a parent work-breakdown split. ABSENT for a normally-authored idea; PRESENT only on a decomposition child, where decompose_check D9 requires it non-empty and exactly equal to the child's owned coverage ids.
